text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Ligne Droite—that concludes the tasks for 
the Expedition Support Committee. 
Now all that remains is assisting the 
executive committee, as I volunteered to 
do... I suppose."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"We must offer our fullest support, of 
course. 
After all, for the King, my beloved 
sister, to show her face is a rare whim 
indeed."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Only the finest dream would be worthy... 
and yet.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"—She said she's not entering this year 
either. Guess the timing just didn't work 
out... 
Is the only noteworthy pair really that 
Tap and Gimlet duo?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
"What happened in the plaza was wild. I 
kinda can't keep up with that energy... 
Maybe I won't bother participating this 
year..."

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—See, everyone's getting turned off. 
That's what happens when you stand out... 
People will just mock you for trying too 
hard anyway."

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I am definitely not clapping for them... 
You guys aren't either... right?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"—Dammit! I'm totally gonna win Best 
Dater, just watch...! 
And then I'll show that—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Vodka-san. 
Could it be... you are troubled over 
Droite?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't mind, would you share it 
with me? 
No matter how trivial... I would be glad 
to help."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...So, I was supposed to enter with 
Scarlet again this year. 
I mean, only 'cause circumstances forced 
our hand, okay?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And yet, some business came up with her 
family out of nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
""Enter even without me! You're gonna 
dance cool, right? 
If you put on some half-assed dance, 
you'll answer to me!""

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"—Can you believe she actually said that 
to me?! 
So I'm definitely, absolutely gonna win 
Best Dater!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make her say 'that was amazing'... 
No, wait! 
I'm gonna shut her right up!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... How wonderful it is to see such 
camaraderie. 
As someone helping with the event 
management, I truly appreciate your 
enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Senpai, on top of 
your work with the Expedition Support 
Committee, 
you're also helping run the event, right! 
Thanks for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's merely a modest contribution. 
I simply wish to create an event that 
everyone can enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To that end, the music, the lighting, and 
the participants must all be beautiful. 
I will spare no effort to make this a 
truly thrilling occasion.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is that right? You really are so 
kind, Senpai! 
That's super reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm thinking of asking 
Gim-senpai to pair up with me! 
We're gonna blow everyone away with some 
insane dance moves!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, with Gimlet-san? 
Well, well... That sounds like it would be 
a truly fitting pair... however...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: However?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it that Gimlet-san is pairing up 
with Tap-san...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wha-WHAAAAAAAT—!? 
Are you for real!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It was creating quite a buzz as a rather 
unusual pairing. 
Ah, but to know the truth of the matter, 
you would have to ask them directly...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
True that!? Alright, I'm gonna go check 
right now! 
I'm not letting anyone have 
Gim-senpaiiiii!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...What an earnest person.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Be it unconventional or orthodox... 
Either way, if the wind changes 
direction...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—And that's why you gotta challenge me! 
The one who's pairing up with Gim-senpai 
is ME!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whew, someone's fired up! Here I was 
wondering what you wanted, 
and you're trying to steal my partner?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Damn right! 
I'm gonna beat you and team up with 
Gim-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've set my sights on winning 
Best Dancer, I ain't compromising. 
I'm gonna show everyone the most badass 
dance ever!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And I know full well I'm not good enough 
to pull that off alone... 
That's why—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm not handing Gim-senpai over to you!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Fine by me, challenge 
accepted! 
I'll teach you that you're a hundred years 
too early to steal treasure from me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What's got you down? 
Looks like my dance skills are still a cut 
above yours.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I sing and dance with my crew every single 
day of my life! 
Any genre is a piece of cake for me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Daaamn it~~ I'm gonna get better from here 
on out! 
I'm not giving up. Next is... a battle of 
rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—Dun dun tis dadun dadun tis! 
—Doooon! Doooon! Boom-shaka-boom-shaka!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—............Nnnngh! 
—When it comes to pure muscle... nghhh...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—HAAAAAAAH—! 
So in the end, it comes down to arm 
wrestling, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose! The one pairing up with 
Gim-senpai is—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SMASH—!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Silence! Ye clashing dragon and tiger!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: G-Gim-senpai!?
